en: A black-and-white image showing a bustling market scene in a European town square. The square is filled with people, mostly women in traditional late 19th or early 20th-century dress, selling and buying goods from baskets. There are several ornate buildings with steep gabled roofs surrounding the square. In the center is a fountain with a statue. Some visible text on the buildings includes 'Café', 'Otto Egert', and 'Uhr Walther'.
